summary.text: Richard Hayes is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 57 who has represented the district since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Richard Hayes was born in Texas and lives in Denton, and he graduated from Denton High School in 1971.
He earned a bachelor's degree in management from Texas Christian University in 1975, an M.B.A. from Texas A&M University in 1976, and a J.D. from St. Mary's University School of Law in 1978.
Hayes worked as a law clerk to Judge Adrian Spears at the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Texas and as an attorney at Hayes, Berry, White & Vanzant.
Hayes took office in the Texas House on January 10, 2023, succeeding Trent Ashby.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as Urban Affairs and International Relations & Economic Development.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Ray Stith and Libertarian Darren Hamilton in the general election.
